content.text:
Yes. No code change needed — endpoints already plain JSON HTTP.

**Stream Deck (needs an HTTP plugin — built-in "Website" action is GET-only, fire is POST-only)**

Install *API Ninja* or *Web Requests* (free, Stream Deck store). One button each:

| Button | Method | URL | Body |
|---|---|---|---|
| WIN | POST | `https://<host>/api/control/<token>/fire` | `{"type":"win"}` |
| LOSS | POST | `.../fire` | `{"type":"lose"}` |
| WIN w/ opponent | POST | `.../fire` | `{"type":"win","opponent":"Shroud"}` |
| +1 win (fix misfire) | POST | `.../score` | `{"type":"win","delta":1}` |
| −1 win | POST | `.../score` | `{"type":"win","delta":-1}` |
| Reset | POST | `.../score` | `{"type":"reset"}` |

Header `Content-Type: application/json`. Token is same one from Settings dock URL.

**Other devices**
- **Bitfocus Companion** (Stream Deck / Loupedeck / X-keys): generic HTTP module, same POST + body.
- **Touch Portal**: built-in HTTP action, same.
- **Loupedeck / any macro pad**: bind key to `curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"type":"win"}' <url>`.
- **No plugin at all**: not possible today — fire has no GET handler.

Security caveat: a Stream Deck profile stores the token in plaintext on disk, and exporting/sharing that profile leaks it. Same blast radius as the dock URL (fire result widgets, ±1 score), so re-mint the token if a profile is shared.

Want a GET variant of `/fire` so the zero-plugin "Website" action works? Say so — but that makes the token a one-click URL anything can hit (link preview bots, browser prefetch), so I'd skip it.
